about_the_game:
🚀 Drift Like a Legend – Conquer the Cosmic Chaos!

Welcome to Space Tournament – the galaxy’s most stylish zero-gravity racing game!
Master tight controls, dodge deadly traps, crush missions, and build your own space-racing challenges. Whether you're chilling with campaign vibes or competing for a spot on the global leaderboard, one thing’s certain:
Space has never raced this hard.


⚙️ Refine your skills, design wild tracks, challenge your crew, and drift like a cosmic boss. In a world with no drag and only two turbines, it’s all about momentum, control, and perfect timing.
Ready to become a legend?

🔥Gameplay

Your ship is powered by just two engines. No steering wheel. No brakes.
Just left, right, and forward – it’s simple… until it’s not.
Zero friction means every move counts. You’ll be drifting, spinning, and course-correcting through asteroid fields, laser grids, space-mines, and high-speed boosters.
It’s chaotic, it’s precise, and once you get it – it feels incredible.
Don’t worry, beginner-friendly ship parts add just enough friction to help you ease in – but the real mastery lies in nailing those clean, godlike drifts.

Climb the global leaderboard or perfect your line through over 40 hand-crafted campaign missions.

Mission Editor

The Mission Editor is the same powerful tool we used to create the main campaign. It’s intuitive, beginner-friendly, and lets you create and share custom missions effortlessly.

Feeling ambitious? Dive deeper to design complex mission objectives using advanced features like blueprints and trigger systems. If you've ever used a design program or game editor, you’ll feel right at home.

Showcase of some features like the blueprint and trigger system

Once you’ve crafted your mission, publish it with a click! Let the world race through your creations and challenge your friends with custom-built chaos.

With user tags, ratings, and a growing library of community missions, you’ll have an endless stream of new content to explore — far beyond the main campaign.
